handmadePremium.name: Arturo Fuente

handmadePremium.name: Padrón
handmadePremium.tagline: 1964 Anniversary, 1926 Serie & Family Reserve
handmadePremium.notes: Montana's largest selection of aged Nicaraguan box-pressed classics.
handmadePremium.description: Established by José Orlando Padrón in Miami in 1964, Padrón cigars are legendary for their vertical integration, aging every leaf of tobacco for up to ten years before rolling. handmadePremium.name: Davidoff

handmadePremium.notes: The gold standard of luxury tobacco, immaculate construction and refinement.

handmadePremium.notes: Classic smooth-to-medium smokes ideal for any time of day.

handmadePremium.name: Oliva

handmadePremium.name: NUB
handmadePremium.tagline: Connecticut, Cameroon, Habano & Maduro
handmadePremium.notes: Innovatively engineered short, stout vitolas capturing the sweet spot instantly.
handmadePremium.description: Engineered by the Oliva Cigar Company, the NUB concept emerged from the theory that a cigar's sweetest, most balanced flavor zone (the sweet spot) occurs in the middle 3.5 to 4 inches.
